text:
Alex: Quick heads-up — PR #26288 is blocked by a flaky CI run on windows-integ-2. Snapshots failing only on Windows.
CI Bot: build 26288/windows-integ-2 failed: 3 tests failed (snapshots).
Maria: Which tests/shard? any diffs you can paste?
Alex: Failing test: SettingsList_snapshot on shard 7 (windows-2022). Small visual diff — pasted snippet from the test run:
```
AssertionError: images differ
Expected hash: 0x1a2b3c
Actual   hash: 0x1a2b4d
Diff at region: toolbar/icons
```
Alex: I repro'd in a Win VM when DPI scaling was 150% (seed=42). Not reproducible at 100%.
Jen: That sounds like font/OS rendering. Do our test harnesses pin fonts or DPI?
Sahil: We don't force DPI today. Try SCALE=100 or --force-fonts. I can trigger a targeted rerun on shard 7 now.
Maria: If it's just rendering noise, we can update the snapshot, but we need a reviewer to OK the update and an issue to track the flaky root cause.
Alex: Agreed — hold merge until we confirm. @team-frontend any volunteers to review snapshot update?
CI Bot: queued targeted rerun: 26288/shard-7 (requested by Sahil). ETA ~5m.
Sahil: rerun started. Locally I passed with SCALE=100, failed with SCALE=150.
Jen: If rerun passes at default infra DPI, let's add a transient skip for windows-scale>=125 and open a follow-up to fix layout.
Alex: I'll open an issue and add the skip in a follow-up commit; prefer not to change tests in this PR.
Maria: OK — I've marked the PR as WIP for now. Alex, please link the issue in the PR description.
Alex: Done — https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/26288 (issue #1142 created).
Sahil: rerun finished: 2 tests passing, 1 still flaky (non-deterministic). Looks like multiple factors.
Jen: I can take a bisect tomorrow to narrow the commit range. In the meantime, can someone approve a manual rerun during the merge window? :eyes:
Maria: I'll approve a snapshot update if the bisect shows it's environmental and you attach the issue. :+1:
Alex: Thanks. Holding merge until bisect + one more clean run.
